name: mcp-broker
description: The ONLY component that speaks the Model Context Protocol (docs/adr/0045). Two jobs in one Deployment: DISCOVERY (watch MCPServer CRs, list each server's tools, publish them to status and materialize the EXPOSED ones as derived MCPTool CRs) and INVOCATION (proxy one tools/call under the CALLER's delegated token). A separate Deployment from agent-orchestrator on purpose: the MCP wire protocol, its sessions and its outbound egress stay out of the deterministic agent loop, exactly as ADR 0014's LocalTool executor keeps a sidecar runtime out of it.
